properties.description: 2026-09-11, after PR #476. The bare-zero class from the tool sweep (D-06/D-12/C-02), for criterion 2 (req:every-tool-description-is-accurate-about-what-the-tool-does): measured on an EMPTY design, 9 of the 39 no-argument read-only tools answered a bare {"count":0,"items":[]} — indistinguishable from a clean design — while one (open_questions) already said which empty through ok_read_empty_speaks, built after a field report and called by nothing else. The fix is a helper (empty_speaks / ok_json_or_why / ok_read_or_why) and one true sentence per tool about what it swept, plus a wire-level gate (tools/empty_speaks.py, in CI) that calls every no-arg read-only tool on an empty store and refuses a bare zero, so a fortieth tool cannot join the class. Must NOT include get_node's {"node":null} on a missing id — an argument-taking read outside this gate's reach, taken with the description-accuracy pass. Sequence 417 follows epoch:a-tool-says-when-you-would-ask-for-it (416).
properties.name: An empty answer says which empty it is
